relevance_review.reason: The provided group contains no core intent or code changes (hunk summaries are empty). Without any modifications to the code, it cannot address the use-after-free vulnerability described in the root cause.

The vulnerability is caused by accessing ade v->id after the structure is freed in the error handling path. The change replaces the access to ade v->id with a local variable id, preventing the dereference of freed memory and directly addressing the use-after-free root cause.

vuln_statements.explanation: This goto statement transfers control to the add_fail error handling path after auxiliary_device_add(adev) succeeds. The add_fail path subsequently calls auxiliary_device_uninit() which triggers the release callback that frees struct mana_adev. Any subsequent access to adev->id in this error path causes use-after-free since the memory has already been freed by the release callback.
